question: For each instance VM state on host 'blaze8-12', list the VM state, the geometric mean of instance memory (MB) across instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' (and memory_mb > 0), and the total instance memory (MB) for that same VM state in availability zone 'flare3' (only including VM states where the total memory is greater than 50000 MB). Do not repeat the VM state if it is the same as the previous row, and include a final TOTAL row that sums the total_memory_mb across all returned VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH geo AS (
  SELECT i.vm_state,
         EXP(AVG(LN(i.memory_mb))) AS geom_mean
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata m
    ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
   AND m.`key` = 'image_image_type'
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.memory_mb > 0
  GROUP BY i.vm_state
),
tot AS (
  SELECT i.vm_state,
         SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
  GROUP BY i.vm_state
  HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 50000
),
combined AS (
  SELECT g.vm_state,
         g.geom_mean,
         t.total_memory_mb
  FROM geo g
  JOIN tot t ON t.vm_state = g.vm_state
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT vm_state,
         geom_mean,
         total_memory_mb,
         LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state) AS prev_vm_state
  FROM combined
)
SELECT CASE WHEN vm_state = prev_vm_state THEN '' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state,
       geom_mean,
       total_memory_mb
FROM with_lag
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TOTAL',
       NULL,
       SUM(total_memory_mb)
FROM combined
ORDER BY CASE WHEN vm_state = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, vm_state
